standard.description: A cobalt-blue padded quilted gilet with a zip front and two side pockets, worn over a grey long-sleeve cotton top with a crew neck; dark brown wool twill trousers with a straight leg and cuffed hems; chunky black rubber-soled lace-up boots that reach the ankle.

A brick-red wool duffle coat with large wooden toggle fastenings down the front and a small standing collar, worn over a white crew-neck long-sleeve top; dark grey slim-fit cotton trousers; dark brown suede pull-on ankle boots with a rounded toe.

A forest-green knitted pullover with a round neck and ribbed cuffs, worn over a white long-sleeve shirt whose cuffs show at the wrists; mid-blue denim jeans with a straight leg; brown lace-up ankle boots; a long rust-orange wool scarf wound twice around the neck with both ends hanging down the front; red knitted mittens on both hands.

A sunshine-yellow fleece zip-up hoodie with a full-length front zip and two hand pockets at the hip, worn over a white long-sleeve thermal top; soft navy blue corduroy pull-on trousers with an elasticated waist and a slightly rounded belly fit; red rubber-soled ankle boots with velcro straps.
